H8601.def: from «0644»; cookery, i.e. (concretely) a cake:--baked piece.

H8602.et: from an unused root meaning to smear
H8602.def: from an unused root meaning to smear; plaster (as gummy) or slime; (figuratively) frivolity:--foolish things, unsavoury, untempered.

H8603.def: from the same as «08602»; quagmire; Tophel, a place near the Desert:--Tophel.

H8604.def: from the same as «08602»; frivolity:--folly, foolishly.

H8605.def: from «06419»; intercession, supplication; by implication, a hymn:--prayer.

H8607.def: from «06452»; ford; Tiphsach, a place in Mesopotamia:--Tipsah.

H8608.def: a primitive root; to drum, i.e. play (as) on the tambourine:--taber, play with timbrels.

H8609.def: a primitive root; to sew:--(women that) sew (together).

H8610.def: a primitive root; to manipulate, i.e. seize; chiefly to capture, wield, specifically, to overlay; figuratively, to use unwarrantably:--catch, handle, (lay, take) hold (on, over), stop, × surely, surprise, take.

H8611.def: from the base of «08608»; a smiting, i.e. (figuratively) contempt:--tabret.

H8612.def: the same as «08611»; Topheth, a place near Jerusalem:--Tophet, Topheth.

H8613.def: probably a form of «08612»; Tophteh, a place of cremation:--Tophet.

H8614.def: (Aramaic) perhaps from «08199»; judicial, i.e. a lawyer:--sheriff.

H8615.def: from «06960»; literally, a cord (as an attachment (compare «06961»)); figuratively, expectancy:--expectation ((-ted)), hope, live, thing that I long for.

H8616.def: the same as «08615»; Tikvah, the name of two Israelites:--Tikvah.

H8619.def: from «08628» (in the musical sense); a trumpet:--trumpet.

H8620.def: a form of «08619»; Tekoa, a place in Palestine:--Tekoa, Tekoah.

H8621.def: or Tqo iy {tek-o-ee'}; patronymically from «08620»; a Tekoite or inhabitant of Tekoah:--Tekoite.

H8622.def: or tquphah {tek-oo-faw'}; from «05362»; a revolution, i.e. (of the sun) course, (of time) lapse:--circuit, come about, end.

H8625.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «08254»; to balance:--Tekel, be weighed.

H8626.def: a primitive root; to equalize, i.e. straighten (intransitive or transitive); figuratively, to compose:--set in order, make straight.

H8627.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «08626»; to straighten up, i.e. confirm:--establish.

H8628.def: a primitive root; to clatter, i.e. slap (the hands together), clang (an instrument); by analogy, to drive (a nail or tent-pin, a dart, etc.); by implication, to become bondsman by handclasping):--blow ((a trumpet)), cast, clap, fasten, pitch (tent), smite, sound, strike, × suretiship, thrust.

H8629.def: from «08628»; a blast of a trumpet:--sound.

H8631.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «08630»; to become (causatively, make) mighty or (figuratively) obstinate:--make firm, harden, be(-come) strong.

H8633.def: from «08630»; might or (figuratively) positiveness:-- authority, power, strength.

H8634.def: probably for «08653»; a reeling; Taralah, a place in Palestine:--Taralah.

H8636.def: from «07235»; multiplication, i.e. percentage or bonus in addition to principal:--increase, unjust gain.

H8637.def: a denominative from «07270»; to cause to walk:--teach to go.

H8638.et: a denominative from (07275) in the sense of throwing over
H8638.def: a denominative from «07275» in the sense of throwing over; to transfer, i.e. translate:--interpret.

H8639.def: from «07290»; a lethargy or (by implication) trance:--deep sleep.

H8640.def: of foreign derivation; Tirhakah, a king of Kush:--Tirhakah.

H8641.def: or trumah (Deut. 12:11) {ter-oo-maw'}; from «07311»; a present (as offered up), especially in sacrifice or as tribute:-- gift, heave offering ((shoulder)), oblation, offered(-ing).

H8643.def: from «07321»; clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry; especially clangor of trumpets, as an alarum:--alarm, blow(- ing) (of, the) (trumpets), joy, jubile, loud noise, rejoicing, shout(-ing), (high, joyful) sound(-ing).

H8644.et: from (07322) in the sense of its congener (07495)
H8644.def: from «07322» in the sense of its congener «07495»; a remedy:--medicine.

H8645.def: probably from «07329»; a species of tree (apparently from its slenderness), perhaps the cypress:--cypress.

H8646.def: of uncertain derivation; Terach, the father of Abraham; also a place in the Desert:--Tarah, Terah.

H8647.def: of uncertain derivation; Tirchanah, an Israelite:--Tirhanah.

H8648.def: (Aramaic) feminine tarteyn {tar-tane'}; corresponding to «08147»; two:--second, + twelve, two.

H8649.def: and tarmuwth {tar-mooth'}; or tarmiyth {tar-meeth'}; from «07411»; fraud:--deceit(-ful), privily.

H8650.def: probably for «0766»; a pole (as a mast or flag-staff):--beacon, mast.

H8651.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «08179»; a door; by implication, a palace:--gate mouth.

H8654.et: patrial from an unused name meaning gate
H8654.def: patrial from an unused name meaning gate; a Tirathite or inhabitant of an unknown Tirah:--Tirathite.

H8655.def: plural from «07495»; a healer; Teraphim (singular or plural) a family idol:--idols(-atry), images, teraphim.

H8656.def: from «07521»; delightsomeness; Tirtsah, a place in Palestine; also an Israelitess:--Tirzah.

H8657.def: of foreign derivation; Teresh, a eunuch of Xerxes:--Teresh.

H8658.def: probably of foreign derivation (compare «08659»); a gem, perhaps the topaz:--beryl.

H8659.et: probably the same as (08658) (as the region of the stone, or the reverse)
H8659.def: probably the same as «08658» (as the region of the stone, or the reverse); Tarshish, a place on the Mediterranean, hence, the ephithet of a merchant vessel (as if for or from that port); also the name of a Persian and of an Israelite:--Tarshish, Tharshish.

H8660.def: of foreign derivation; the title of a Persian deputy or governor:--Tirshatha.

H8661.def: of foreign derivation; Tartan, an Assyrian:--Tartan.

H8662.def: of foreign derivation; Tartak, a deity of the Avvites:--Tartak.

H8663.def: from «07722»; a crashing or loud clamor:--crying, noise, shouting, stir.

H8664.et: patrial from an unused name meaning recourse
H8664.def: patrial from an unused name meaning recourse; a Tishbite or inhabitant of Tishbeh (in Gilead):--Tishbite.

H8666.def: or tshubah {tesh-oo-baw'}; from «07725»; a recurrence (of time or place); a reply (as returned):--answer, be expired, return.

H8667.def: from «07760»; a deposit, i.e. pledging:--+ fellowship.

H8668.def: or tshuah {tesh-oo-aw'}; from «07768» in the sense of «03467»; rescue (literal or figurative, pers., national or spir.):-- deliverance, help, safety, salvation, victory.

H8669.et: from (07783) in the original sense of stretching out after
H8669.def: from «07783» in the original sense of stretching out after; a longing:--desire.

H8670.et: from (07788) in the sense of arrival
H8670.def: from «07788» in the sense of arrival; a gift:--present.

H8672.et: perhaps from (08159) through the idea of a turn to the next or full number ten
H8672.def: or (masculine) tishtah {tish-aw'}; perhaps from «08159» through the idea of a turn to the next or full number ten; nine or (ord.) ninth:--nine (+ -teen, + -teenth, -th).

H8674.def: of foreign derivation; Tattenai, a Persian:--Tatnai.
